        WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
          AND (
                e.block = 'd'
                OR e.group_number BETWEEN 3 AND 12
                OR c.element IN (
                    'Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg'
                )
              )
      )
ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST, me.reduced_formula
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型金属間化合物において、相安定性、格子ミスマッチ、弾性特性を同時に考慮した析出強化相候補を抽出して。
sql:
WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        p.entry_id,
        p.formula,
        p.reduced_formula,
        sp.prototype,
        sp.strukturbericht,
        sp.space_group_number,
        sp.crystal_system,
        sp.lattice_a,
        sp.formula_type,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable AS phase_is_stable,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.poisson_ratio,
        et.is_stable AS elastic_is_stable,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        mas.phase
    FROM material_entry p
    JOIN structure sp
        ON sp.entry_id = p.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = p.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = p.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
        ON mas.entry_id = p.entry_id
    WHERE
        p.number_of_elements >= 2
        AND (
            UPPER(
                REGEXP_REPLACE(
                    COALESCE(sp.strukturbericht, '') || ' ' ||
                    COALESCE(sp.prototype, '') || ' ' ||
                    COALESCE(sp.formula_type, ''),
                    '[^A-Za-z0-9]',
                    '',
                    'g'
                )
            ) LIKE '%L12%'
            OR UPPER(COALESCE(sp.prototype, '')) LIKE '%CU3AU%'
            OR UPPER(COALESCE(sp.prototype, '')) LIKE '%AUCU3%'
            OR (
                sp.space_group_number = 221
                AND UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(sp.formula_type, ''), ' ', '')) IN ('AB3', 'A3B')
            )
        )
),
matrix_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        mas_m.alloy_system_id,
        m.entry_id,
        m.formula,
        sm.lattice_a,
        sm.prototype,
        sm.strukturbericht
    FROM material_alloy_system mas_m
    JOIN material_entry m
        ON m.entry_id = mas_m.entry_id
    JOIN structure sm
        ON sm.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE
        sm.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            mas_m.phase ILIKE '%matrix%'
            OR UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(sm.strukturbericht, ''), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'A1'
            OR sm.prototype ILIKE '%fcc%'
            OR sm.space_group_number = 225
        )
)
SELECT
    p.entry_id AS precipitate_entry_id,
    p.formula AS precipitate_formula,
    p.reduced_formula AS precipitate_reduced_formula,
    als.system_name AS alloy_system,
    p.phase AS precipitate_phase,
    p.prototype,
    p.strukturbericht,
    p.space_group_number,
    p.crystal_system,
    p.lattice_a AS precipitate_lattice_a,
    m.entry_id AS matrix_entry_id,
    m.formula AS matrix_formula,
    m.lattice_a AS matrix_lattice_a,
    ABS(p.lattice_a - m.lattice_a) / NULLIF(m.lattice_a, 0) AS lattice_mismatch,
    p.formation_energy_per_atom,
    p.energy_above_hull,
    p.phase_is_stable,
    p.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    p.shear_modulus_vrh,
    p.youngs_modulus,
    p.poisson_ratio,
    p.elastic_is_stable,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.phase_is_stable, FALSE)
                 OR COALESCE(p.energy_above_hull, 999.0) <= 0.10
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        +
        CASE
            WHEN m.entry_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND p.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
                 AND m.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
                 AND ABS(p.lattice_a - m.lattice_a) / NULLIF(m.lattice_a, 0) <= 0.05
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        +
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.elastic_is_stable, FALSE)
                 OR p.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
                 OR p.youngs_modulus IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS candidate_score
FROM l12_candidates p
LEFT JOIN alloy_system als
    ON als.alloy_system_id = p.alloy_system_id
LEFT JOIN matrix_candidates m
    ON m.alloy_system_id = p.alloy_system_id
    AND m.entry_id <> p.entry_id
WHERE
    p.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        p.phase_is_stable IS NULL
        OR p.phase_is_stable
        OR p.energy_above_hull IS NULL
        OR p.energy_above_hull <= 0.15
    )
    AND (
        m.entry_id IS NULL
        OR ABS(p.lattice_a - m.lattice_a) / NULLIF(m.lattice_a, 0) <= 0.10
    )
ORDER BY
    candidate_score DESC,
    p.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    lattice_mismatch ASC NULLS LAST,
    p.shear_modulus_vrh DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Al代替またはCo基γ'相候補として有望なL1₂型金属間化合物を、形成エネルギー、格子定数、弾性率の観点から探索して。
γ'相候補のランキングを安定性・格子整合性・バルクモジュラスの重み付きスコアで出して。
NiまたはCo含有で安定かつバルクモジュラスが高いL1₂化合物トップ10を出して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS max_bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition AS c
        WHERE
            c.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
    )
GROUP BY
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull
ORDER BY
    max_bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: L1₂型化合物の元素組み合わせと安定性の関係をAサイト・Bサイト別に集計して材料設計の指針を得たい。
sql:
WITH l12_materials AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        MAX(c.element) FILTER (WHERE c.site_label ILIKE 'A%') AS a_site_element,
        MAX(c.element) FILTER (WHERE c.site_label ILIKE 'B%') AS b_site_element
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    GROUP BY
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula
)
SELECT
    lm.a_site_element,
    lm.b_site_element,
    COUNT(*) AS num_compounds,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable) AS stable_count,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        3
    ) AS stable_fraction,
    AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
    AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
    MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) AS min_energy_above_hull,
    AVG(ps.band_gap) AS avg_band_gap,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT lm.formula ORDER BY lm.formula) AS example_formulas
FROM l12_materials lm
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = lm.entry_id
WHERE
    lm.a_site_element IS NOT NULL
    AND lm.b_site_element IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    lm.a_site_element,
    lm.b_site_element
ORDER BY
    stable_fraction DESC,
    avg_energy_above_hull ASC,
    num_compounds DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni3Alの格子定数に近く、バルクモジュラスが高く、安定なL1₂候補を総合的にランキングして。
sql:
WITH ni3al_target AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(AVG(s.lattice_a), 3.57) AS target_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE (
        me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    )
    AND (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    )
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.lattice_a,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - nt.target_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_abs_diff,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - nt.target_lattice_a) / NULLIF(nt.target_lattice_a, 0) AS lattice_a_rel_diff,
        nt.target_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_target nt
    WHERE (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    )
    AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        1.0 - LEAST(c.lattice_a_rel_diff / 0.05, 1.0) AS lattice_match_score,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY c.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_score,
        CASE
            WHEN c.is_stable THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 - LEAST(c.energy_above_hull / 0.10, 1.0)
        END AS stability_score
    FROM candidates c
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            (
                0.40 * lattice_match_score
              + 0.35 * bulk_modulus_score
              + 0.25 * stability_score
            ) DESC,
            energy_above_hull ASC,
            bulk_modulus_vrh DESC,
            lattice_a_abs_diff ASC
    ) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    space_group_number,
    crystal_system,
    lattice_a,
    target_lattice_a AS ni3al_lattice_a,
    lattice_a_abs_diff,
    lattice_a_rel_diff,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    energy_above_hull,
    is_stable,
    lattice_match_score,
    bulk_modulus_score,
    stability_score,
    (
        0.40 * lattice_match_score
      + 0.35 * bulk_modulus_score
      + 0.25 * stability_score
    ) AS total_score
FROM scored
WHERE stability_score > 0
ORDER BY
    total_score DESC,
    energy_above_hull ASC,
    bulk_modulus_vrh DESC,
    lattice_a_abs_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 析出強化に適したL1₂化合物を格子ミスマッチ、弾性率、安定性の多基準で評価して上位候補を出して。
sql:
WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.formula_type,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.lattice_a AS precipitate_lattice_a,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND me.number_of_elements >= 2
        AND (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu₃Au%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
            OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
                AND me.number_of_elements = 2
            )
        )
),
dominant_element AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.entry_id)
        c.entry_id,
        c.element AS matrix_element,
        c.atomic_fraction
    FROM composition c
    JOIN l12_candidates l12
        ON l12.entry_id = c.entry_id
    ORDER BY c.entry_id, c.atomic_fraction DESC
),
fcc_matrix AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (me.reduced_formula)
        me.reduced_formula AS matrix_element,
        s.lattice_a AS matrix_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        me.number_of_elements = 1
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            s.space_group_number = 225
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%fcc%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%A1%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%A1%'
        )
    ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, s.lattice_a
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        l12.entry_id,
        l12.formula,
        l12.reduced_formula,
        l12.chemical_system,
        de.matrix_element,
        l12.prototype,
        l12.strukturbericht,
        l12.precipitate_lattice_a,
        COALESCE(
            fm.matrix_lattice_a,
            2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0
        ) AS matrix_lattice_a,
        100.0
            * ABS(
                l12.precipitate_lattice_a
                - COALESCE(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0)
            )
            / COALESCE(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0)
            AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
        l12.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        l12.shear_modulus_vrh,
        l12.youngs_modulus,
        l12.formation_energy_per_atom,
        l12.energy_above_hull,
        l12.is_stable,
        (
            0.40 * GREATEST(
                0.0,
                1.0 - LEAST(
                    100.0
                        * ABS(
                            l12.precipitate_lattice_a
                            - COALESCE(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0)
                        )
                        / COALESCE(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0),
                    10.0
                ) / 10.0
            )
            + 0.30 * LEAST(
                COALESCE(
                    l12.youngs_modulus,
                    9.0 * l12.bulk_modulus_vrh * l12.shear_modulus_vrh
                        / NULLIF(3.0 * l12.bulk_modulus_vrh + l12.shear_modulus_vrh, 0.0),
                    0.0
                ) / 300.0,
                1.0
            )
            + 0.30 * GREATEST(
                0.0,
                1.0 - LEAST(COALESCE(l12.energy_above_hull, 0.20), 0.20) / 0.20
            )
        ) AS precipitation_strengthening_score
    FROM l12_candidates l12
    JOIN dominant_element de
        ON de.entry_id = l12.entry_id
    JOIN element e
        ON e.symbol = de.matrix_element
    LEFT JOIN fcc_matrix fm
        ON fm.matrix_element = de.matrix_element
    WHERE
        COALESCE(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    matrix_element,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    precipitate_lattice_a,
    matrix_lattice_a,
    lattice_mismatch_percent,
    youngs_modulus,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    shear_modulus_vrh,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    energy_above_hull,
    is_stable,
    precipitation_strengthening_score
FROM scored
WHERE
    lattice_mismatch_percent <= 10.0
    AND COALESCE(energy_above_hull, 0.20) <= 0.20
ORDER BY
    precipitation_strengthening_score DESC,
    lattice_mismatch_percent ASC,
    COALESCE(energy_above_hull, 0.20) ASC,
    youngs_modulus DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

question: Co基超合金のγ'相候補として、Co含有で安定なL1₂化合物をNi3Alとの比較で評価して。
L1₂型化合物データベースから、バルクモジュラスとせん断弾性率の比(B/G比)を計算して延性候補を抽出して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.space_group_number,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh, 0) AS bg_ratio,
    et.youngs_modulus,
    et.poisson_ratio,
    et.is_stable
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', '') = 'L12'
        OR REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', '') LIKE '%L12%'
    )
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND et.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND et.shear_modulus_vrh > 0
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh, 0) >= 1.75
    AND et.is_stable IS TRUE
ORDER BY
    bg_ratio DESC,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物の安定性マップ（formation energy vs energy above hull）を出力して、候補を4象限に分類して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.space_group_number,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= 0
             AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
            THEN 'Q1: favorable formation / on-or-near hull'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom > 0
             AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
            THEN 'Q2: unfavorable formation / on-or-near hull'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= 0
             AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05
            THEN 'Q3: favorable formation / above hull'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom > 0
             AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05
            THEN 'Q4: unfavorable formation / above hull'
        ELSE 'unclassified'
    END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
ORDER BY
    stability_quadrant,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 元素周期の観点から、3d遷移金属と4d/5d遷移金属をAサイトに持つL1₂化合物の安定性傾向を比較して。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id
  FROM material_entry me
  LEFT JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
    ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE
    (
      COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1-2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1 2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1-2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1 2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu_3Au%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu%3%Au%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%AuCu_3%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%AuCu%3%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.phase, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.phase, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.phase, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.composition_type, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.composition_type, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.composition_type, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR (
        s.space_group_number = 221
        AND me.number_of_elements = 2
        AND (
          COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE '%A3B%'
          OR COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE '%AB3%'
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM composition c0
            WHERE c0.entry_id = me.entry_id
              AND (
                c0.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
                OR c0.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 70 AND 80
              )
          )
        )
      )
    )
),
composition_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.element,
    c.site_label,
    CASE
      WHEN c.atomic_fraction > 1 THEN c.atomic_fraction / 100.0
      ELSE c.atomic_fraction
    END AS atomic_fraction_norm,
    BOOL_OR(
      c.site_label ILIKE 'A%'
      OR c.site_label ILIKE '%A-site%'
      OR c.site_label ILIKE '%A site%'
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY c.entry_id) AS has_explicit_a_site,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN c.atomic_fraction > 1 THEN c.atomic_fraction / 100.0
        ELSE c.atomic_fraction
      END
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY c.entry_id) AS max_atomic_fraction_norm
  FROM composition c
  JOIN l12_entries le
    ON le.entry_id = c.entry_id
  WHERE c.element IS NOT NULL
),
a_site_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cn.entry_id,
    cn.element
  FROM composition_normalized cn
  WHERE
    (
      cn.site_label ILIKE 'A%'
      OR cn.site_label ILIKE '%A-site%'
      OR cn.site_label ILIKE '%A site%'
      OR (
        NOT cn.has_explicit_a_site
        AND cn.atomic_fraction_norm = cn.max_atomic_fraction_norm
        AND cn.atomic_fraction_norm >= 0.50
      )
    )
),
ps_by_entry AS (
  SELECT
    ps.entry_id,
    BOOL_OR(COALESCE(ps.is_stable, FALSE)) AS is_stable,
    AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
    AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull
  FROM phase_stability ps
  GROUP BY ps.entry_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN e.period_number = 4 THEN '3d transition metal on A site'
    WHEN e.period_number IN (5, 6) THEN '4d/5d transition metal on A site'
  END AS a_site_period_class,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS num_l12_compounds,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable) AS num_stable_compounds,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable)::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id), 0),
    4
  ) AS stable_fraction,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull) AS median_energy_above_hull,
  MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) AS min_energy_above_hull,
  MAX(ps.energy_above_hull) AS max_energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry me
JOIN l12_entries le
  ON le.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN a_site_candidates ac
  ON ac.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN element e
  ON e.symbol = ac.element
LEFT JOIN ps_by_entry ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE e.period_number IN (4, 5, 6)
  AND (
    LOWER(COALESCE(e.block, '')) = 'd'
    OR COALESCE(e.category, '') ILIKE '%transition%'
  )
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN e.period_number = 4 THEN '3d transition metal on A site'
    WHEN e.period_number IN (5, 6) THEN '4d/5d transition metal on A site'
  END
ORDER BY avg_energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂化合物のうちNi3Alより安定でバルクモジュラスが高い候補を出して。
sql:
WITH ni3al AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
            OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        )
        AND (
            LOWER(REPLACE(s.prototype, '_', '')) IN ('l12', 'l1₂')
            OR LOWER(REPLACE(s.strukturbericht, '_', '')) IN ('l12', 'l1₂')
        )
        AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
        AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh,
    et.youngs_modulus,
    n.ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom,
    n.ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al n
WHERE
    (
        LOWER(REPLACE(s.prototype, '_', '')) IN ('l12', 'l1₂')
        OR LOWER(REPLACE(s.strukturbericht, '_', '')) IN ('l12', 'l1₂')
    )
    AND NOT (
        me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    )
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < n.ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh > n.ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 全L1₂化合物について、安定性スコア×格子整合性スコア×弾性スコアの複合スコアを計算してランキングして。
sql:
WITH l12 AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.lattice_a,
        s.lattice_b,
        s.lattice_c,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable AS phase_is_stable,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.poisson_ratio,
        et.is_stable AS elastic_is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
            OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
        )
        AND ps.is_stable IS TRUE
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        EXP(-GREATEST(COALESCE(energy_above_hull, 1.0), 0.0) / 0.050) AS stability_score,
        EXP(
            -(
                ABS(lattice_a - lattice_b) / NULLIF((lattice_a + lattice_b) / 2.0, 0.0)
              + ABS(lattice_b - lattice_c) / NULLIF((lattice_b + lattice_c) / 2.0, 0.0)
              + ABS(lattice_c - lattice_a) / NULLIF((lattice_c + lattice_a) / 2.0, 0.0)
            ) / 3.0 / 0.010
        ) AS lattice_matching_score,
        CASE
            WHEN elastic_is_stable IS FALSE THEN 0.0
            ELSE
                LEAST(
                    1.0,
                    GREATEST(COALESCE(bulk_modulus_vrh, 0.0), 0.0) / 200.0
                )
                *
                LEAST(
                    1.0,
                    GREATEST(COALESCE(shear_modulus_vrh, 0.0), 0.0) / 100.0
                )
        END AS elastic_score
    FROM l12
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            stability_score * lattice_matching_score * elastic_score DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    space_group_number,
    crystal_system,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_b,
    lattice_c,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    energy_above_hull,
    phase_is_stable,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    shear_modulus_vrh,
    youngs_modulus,
    poisson_ratio,
    elastic_is_stable,
    stability_score,
    lattice_matching_score,
    elastic_score,
    stability_score * lattice_matching_score * elastic_score AS composite_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY composite_score DESC NULLS LAST, entry_id
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni3Al代替γ'相候補をバルクモジュラス、形成エネルギー、格子ミスマッチの3軸パレート面で出力して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (
            COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L1_2%'
         OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L12%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Ni3Al%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
         OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
            AND s.formula_type IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
            )
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Ni'
            AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.74 AND 0.76
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Al'
            AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.24 AND 0.26
      )
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
        MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
        MIN(ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / NULLIF(r.ni3al_lattice_a, 0) * 100.0) AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
        BOOL_OR(ps.is_stable) AS is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
    WHERE r.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
      AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND (
            COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L1_2%'
         OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L12%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Ni3Al%'
         OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
            AND s.formula_type IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
            )
      )
      AND NOT (
          EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM composition c
              WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
                AND c.element = 'Ni'
                AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.74 AND 0.76
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM composition c
              WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
                AND c.element = 'Al'
                AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.24 AND 0.26
          )
      )
    GROUP BY
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system
)
SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.formula,
    c.reduced_formula,
    c.chemical_system,
    c.prototype,
    c.strukturbericht,
    c.space_group_number,
    c.crystal_system,
    c.bulk_modulus_gpa,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom,
    c.lattice_mismatch_percent,
    c.is_stable
FROM candidates c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM candidates d
    WHERE d.bulk_modulus_gpa >= c.bulk_modulus_gpa
      AND d.formation_energy_per_atom <= c.formation_energy_per_atom
      AND d.lattice_mismatch_percent <= c.lattice_mismatch_percent
      AND (
             d.bulk_modulus_gpa > c.bulk_modulus_gpa
          OR d.formation_energy_per_atom < c.formation_energy_per_atom
          OR d.lattice_mismatch_percent < c.lattice_mismatch_percent
      )
)
ORDER BY
    c.lattice_mismatch_percent ASC,
    c.bulk_modulus_gpa DESC,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物データベースから材料設計仮説を導出するため、安定化合物の元素分布とその物性傾向を包括的に集計して。
次世代γ'相候補として、Ni-Al-Co-Ti四元系でL1₂構造をとりうる組成を探索して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    comp.composition,
    comp.ni_atomic_fraction,
    comp.al_atomic_fraction,
    comp.co_atomic_fraction,
    comp.ti_atomic_fraction,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.volume_per_atom,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        STRING_AGG(c.element || ':' || ROUND(c.atomic_fraction::numeric, 4)::text, ', ' ORDER BY c.element) AS composition,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.element = 'Ni') AS ni_atomic_fraction,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.element = 'Al') AS al_atomic_fraction,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.element = 'Co') AS co_atomic_fraction,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.element = 'Ti') AS ti_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition AS c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
    HAVING ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT c.element ORDER BY c.element) = ARRAY['Al', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Ti']::text[]
) AS comp
    ON comp.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE me.number_of_elements = 4
  AND (
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
          UPPER(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₁₂₃_ -', '123')),
          '[^A-Z0-9]',
          '',
          'g'
      ) = 'L12'
      OR REGEXP_REPLACE(
          UPPER(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₁₂₃_ -', '123')),
          '[^A-Z0-9]',
          '',
          'g'
      ) LIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
  )
ORDER BY
    ps.is_stable DESC NULLS LAST,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Alに近い格子定数を持つL1₂化合物を探して。
sql:
WITH composition_summary AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        COUNT(*) AS n_elements,
        MIN(c.atomic_fraction) AS min_atomic_fraction,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) AS max_atomic_fraction,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Ni' AND ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.75) <= 0.02) AS has_ni_3,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Al' AND ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.25) <= 0.02) AS has_al_1
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition_summary cs
        ON cs.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE cs.n_elements = 2
      AND cs.has_ni_3
      AND cs.has_al_1
      AND s.space_group_number = 221
),
l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
        s.lattice_a,
        s.lattice_b,
        s.lattice_c
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition_summary cs
        ON cs.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE cs.n_elements = 2
      AND s.space_group_number = 221
      AND ABS(cs.min_atomic_fraction - 0.25) <= 0.02
      AND ABS(cs.max_atomic_fraction - 0.75) <= 0.02
)
SELECT
    l.entry_id,
    l.formula,
    l.space_group_symbol,
    l.lattice_a,
    l.lattice_b,
    l.lattice_c,
    n.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(l.lattice_a - n.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    ABS(l.lattice_a - n.ni3al_lattice_a) / n.ni3al_lattice_a * 100.0 AS lattice_a_difference_percent
FROM l12_candidates l
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref n
WHERE l.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
ORDER BY lattice_a_difference ASC
LIMIT 50;

question: L1₂型化合物の形成エネルギー分布を教えて。
sql:
WITH l12_formation AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom::numeric AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        )
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS min_fe,
        MAX(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS max_fe
    FROM l12_formation
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT
        lf.*,
        b.min_fe,
        b.max_fe,
        CASE
            WHEN b.min_fe = b.max_fe THEN 1
            ELSE LEAST(
                GREATEST(
                    width_bucket(lf.formation_energy_ev_per_atom, b.min_fe, b.max_fe, 20),
                    1
                ),
                20
            )
        END AS bucket_no
    FROM l12_formation AS lf
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
)
SELECT
    bucket_no,
    CASE
        WHEN min_fe = max_fe THEN min_fe
        ELSE min_fe + (bucket_no - 1) * (max_fe - min_fe) / 20
    END AS formation_energy_bin_min_ev_per_atom,
    CASE
        WHEN min_fe = max_fe THEN max_fe
        ELSE min_fe + bucket_no * (max_fe - min_fe) / 20
    END AS formation_energy_bin_max_ev_per_atom,
    COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id) AS compound_count,
    AVG(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    MIN(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS observed_min_ev_per_atom,
    MAX(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS observed_max_ev_per_atom
FROM bucketed

question: L1₂型化合物において、Aサイト元素とBサイト元素の組み合わせが形成エネルギーに与える傾向を調べて。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.65 AND 0.85 THEN c.element END) AS a_site_element,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.15 AND 0.35 THEN c.element END) AS b_site_element
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN composition c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        me.number_of_elements = 2
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM structure s
            WHERE s.entry_id = me.entry_id
              AND (
                  s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1%2%'
                  OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
                  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%2%'
                  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
                  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
                  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
                  OR (
                      s.space_group_number = 221
                      AND (
                          s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
                          OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
                      )
                  )
              )
        )
    GROUP BY me.entry_id
    HAVING
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) = 2
        AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.65 AND 0.85) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.15 AND 0.35) = 1
),
formation_energies AS (
    SELECT
        ps.entry_id,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy
    FROM phase_stability ps
    WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        cal.entry_id,
        cp.value AS formation_energy
    FROM calculation cal
    JOIN calculated_property cp
        ON cp.calculation_id = cal.calculation_id
    WHERE
        cp.value IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            cp.property_name ILIKE '%formation%'
            OR cp.property_name ILIKE '%form%energy%'
        )
),
entry_formation_energy AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        AVG(formation_energy) AS formation_energy
    FROM formation_energies
    GROUP BY entry_id
)
SELECT
    l.a_site_element,
    l.b_site_element,
    COUNT(*) AS compound_count,
    AVG(f.formation_energy) AS avg_formation_energy,
    STDDEV_SAMP(f.formation_energy) AS stddev_formation_energy,
    MIN(f.formation_energy) AS min_formation_energy,
    MAX(f.formation_energy) AS max_formation_energy
FROM l12_entries l
JOIN entry_formation_energy f
    ON f.entry_id = l.entry_id
WHERE
    l.a_site_element IS NOT NULL
    AND l.b_site_element IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    l.a_site_element,
    l.b_site_element
ORDER BY
    avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂構造を持つ化合物のうち、格子定数がNi₃Alに近く、形成エネルギーが低い候補を抽出して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE regexp_replace(me.formula, '\s+', '', 'g') IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.prototype,
    s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
    s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant_a,
    r.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_constant_difference,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a * 100.0 AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref AS r
WHERE (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
     OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
     OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
     OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
)
  AND regexp_replace(me.formula, '\s+', '', 'g') NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  AND r.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a <= 0.02
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    lattice_mismatch_percent ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 形成エネルギーが-0.3以下で格子定数が3.5〜3.7ÅのL1₂化合物を抽出して。

    AND (

        ) ILIKE '%L12%'

question: Co基L1₂化合物のうち、Ni₃Alに近い格子定数のものを安定性順に出して。

WITH ni3al AS (
    SELECT s.lattice_a AS ref_lattice_constant
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN composition c_ni ON c_ni.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition c_al ON c_al.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE c_ni.element = 'Ni'
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'
      AND c_ni.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.72 AND 0.78
      AND c_al.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.22 AND 0.28
      AND (
          s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      )
    ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant,
    ni3al.ref_lattice_constant AS ni3al_lattice_constant,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - ni3al.ref_lattice_constant) AS lattice_constant_difference,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry me
JOIN composition c_co ON c_co.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al
WHERE c_co.element = 'Co'
  AND c_co.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
  )
ORDER BY
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - ni3al.ref_lattice_constant) ASC;

question: Co3TiとNi3Alの格子定数差を計算して。
sql:
WITH lattice AS (
    SELECT
        me.formula,
        AVG(s.lattice_a) AS a,
        AVG(s.lattice_b) AS b,
        AVG(s.lattice_c) AS c
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
    GROUP BY me.formula
)
SELECT
    co.a AS co3ti_lattice_a,
    ni.a AS ni3al_lattice_a,
    co.a - ni.a AS lattice_a_difference,
    ABS(co.a - ni.a) AS absolute_lattice_a_difference,
    co.b AS co3ti_lattice_b,
    ni.b AS ni3al_lattice_b,
    co.b - ni.b AS lattice_b_difference,
    ABS(co.b - ni.b) AS absolute_lattice_b_difference,
    co.c AS co3ti_lattice_c,
    ni.c AS ni3al_lattice_c,
    co.c - ni.c AS lattice_c_difference,
    ABS(co.c - ni.c) AS absolute_lattice_c_difference
FROM lattice AS co
JOIN lattice AS ni
    ON co.formula = 'Co3Ti'
   AND ni.formula = 'Ni3Al'
LIMIT 10000;

question: Bサイト元素ごとの安定L1₂化合物数を集計して。
sql:
WITH stable_l12_entries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id
  FROM material_entry AS me
  JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE (
      s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
      OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
    )
    AND (
      ps.is_stable = TRUE
      OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
    )
),
b_site_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.element,
    c.atomic_fraction,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.entry_id
      ORDER BY c.atomic_fraction ASC, c.element
    ) AS rn
  FROM composition AS c
  JOIN stable_l12_entries AS sle
    ON sle.entry_id = c.entry_id
  WHERE c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
)
SELECT
  bsc.element AS b_site_element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bsc.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM b_site_candidates AS bsc
WHERE bsc.rn = 1
GROUP BY bsc.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC, b_site_element
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂化合物の格子ミスマッチ（Ni3Alとの差）を計算して小さい順に表示して。

WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS a_ni3al
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
      ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.lattice_a AS lattice_parameter_a,
    n.a_ni3al AS ni3al_lattice_parameter_a,
    s.lattice_a - n.a_ni3al AS lattice_mismatch_a,
    100.0 * (s.lattice_a - n.a_ni3al) / NULLIF(n.a_ni3al, 0) AS lattice_mismatch_percent
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref AS n
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - n.a_ni3al) ASC, me.formula

question: Fe含有L1₂化合物の安定性と弾性特性を同時に表示して。

    c11.value AS c11,
    c12.value AS c12,

FROM material_entry AS me

    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id

    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id

    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN calculation AS calc
    ON calc.calculation_id = et.calculation_id

    ON c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

LEFT JOIN calculated_property AS c12
    ON c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

  AND (
      s.prototype ILIKE 'L1\_2' ESCAPE '\'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L12'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L1₂'

    WHERE me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L1\_2%' ESCAPE '\'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1\_2%' ESCAPE '\'
         OR s.space_group_number = 221
      )
    ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.reduced_formula,
        s.prototype,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - n.ni3al_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
        ABS(ps.energy_above_hull - n.ni3al_ehull) AS stability_difference,
        (
            ABS(s.lattice_a - n.ni3al_a) / NULLIF(n.ni3al_a, 0)
            +
            ABS(ps.energy_above_hull - n.ni3al_ehull)
        ) AS similarity_score
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al n
    WHERE me.reduced_formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L1\_2%' ESCAPE '\'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1\_2%' ESCAPE '\'
         OR s.space_group_number = 221
      )
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    reduced_formula,
    prototype,
    space_group_number,
    lattice_a,
    energy_above_hull,
    lattice_a_difference,
    stability_difference,
    similarity_score
FROM candidates
ORDER BY similarity_score ASC
LIMIT 20;

question: Aサイト元素がNiまたはCoで、Bサイト元素がAlまたはTiのL1₂化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    a.element AS a_site_element,
    b.element AS b_site_element
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS a
    ON a.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS b
    ON b.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE (
        regexp_replace(
            upper(
                translate(
                    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') || ' ' ||
                    COALESCE(s.prototype, '') || ' ' ||
                    COALESCE(s.formula_type, ''),
                    '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉',
                    '0123456789'
                )
            ),
            '[^A-Z0-9]',
            '',
            'g'
        ) LIKE '%L12%'
        OR regexp_replace(
            upper(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')),
            '[^A-Z0-9]',
            '',
            'g'
        ) LIKE '%CU3AU%'
      )
  AND a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY me.entry_id
LIMIT 10000;

question: 遷移金属を含むL1₂型化合物のうち安定なものを出して。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, pde.hull_distance) AS energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry AS pde
    ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        OR (
            s.space_group_number = 221
            AND (
                s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
                OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
            )
        )
    )
    AND (
        ps.is_stable = TRUE
        OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
        OR pde.is_on_hull = TRUE
        OR pde.hull_distance <= 0.001
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition AS c
        JOIN element AS e
            ON e.symbol = c.element
        WHERE
            c.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND (
                e.category ILIKE '%transition%'
                OR e.block = 'd'
            )
    )
ORDER BY
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, pde.hull_distance) ASC NULLS LAST,
    me.formula
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型金属間化合物において、相安定性、格子ミスマッチ、弾性特性を同時に考慮した析出強化相候補を抽出して。
sql:
WITH l12_phases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (me.entry_id, mas.alloy_system_id)
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        ast.system_name AS alloy_system_name,
        s.lattice_a AS l12_lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.poisson_ratio
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN material_alloy_system mas
        ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN alloy_system ast
        ON ast.alloy_system_id = mas.alloy_system_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
        )
        AND s.lattice_a > 0
        AND COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 999) <= 0.20
        AND COALESCE(ps.formation_energy_per_atom, -1) < 0
        AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh > 0
        AND et.shear_modulus_vrh > 0
        AND et.youngs_modulus > 0
        AND COALESCE(et.is_stable, TRUE) = TRUE
    ORDER BY
        me.entry_id,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
),
fcc_matrices AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (me.entry_id)
        me.entry_id AS matrix_entry_id,
        me.formula AS matrix_formula,
        me.chemical_system AS matrix_chemical_system,
        s.lattice_a AS matrix_lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull AS matrix_energy_above_hull,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh AS matrix_shear_modulus,
        et.youngs_modulus AS matrix_youngs_modulus
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.space_group_number = 225
            OR s.space_group ILIKE 'Fm-3m'
            OR s.space_group ILIKE 'F m -3 m'
        )
        AND NOT (
            COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        )
        AND s.lattice_a > 0
        AND COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 999) <= 0.20
        AND et.shear_modulus_vrh > 0
        AND et.youngs_modulus > 0
    ORDER BY
        me.entry_id,
        ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
),
compatible_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        l.*,
        f.matrix_entry_id,
        f.matrix_formula,
        f.matrix_lattice_a,
        f.matrix_energy_above_hull,
        f.matrix_shear_modulus,
        f.matrix_youngs_modulus,
        100.0 * ABS(l.l12_lattice_a - f.matrix_lattice_a) / NULLIF(f.matrix_lattice_a, 0) AS lattice_mismatch_percent
    FROM l12_phases l
    JOIN fcc_matrices f
        ON l.entry_id <> f.matrix_entry_id
       AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM composition lc
            JOIN composition fc
                ON fc.element = lc.element
            WHERE lc.entry_id = l.entry_id
              AND fc.entry_id = f.matrix_entry_id
       )
    WHERE
        ABS(l.l12_lattice_a - f.matrix_lattice_a) / NULLIF(f.matrix_lattice_a, 0) <= 0.08
)
SELECT
    entry_id AS precipitate_entry_id,
    formula AS precipitate_formula,
    matrix_entry_id,
    matrix_formula,
    alloy_system_id,
    alloy_system_name,
    energy_above_hull,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    lattice_mismatch_percent,
    bulk_modulus,
    shear_modulus,
    youngs_modulus,
    poisson_ratio,
    (
        1.0 / (1.0 + COALESCE(energy_above_hull, 0))
        + 1.0 / (1.0 + lattice_mismatch_percent)
        + shear_modulus / NULLIF(matrix_shear_modulus, 0)
        + youngs_modulus / NULLIF(matrix_youngs_modulus, 0)
    ) AS candidate_score
FROM compatible_pairs
WHERE
    shear_modulus >= 0.8 * matrix_shear_modulus
    AND youngs_modulus >= 0.8 * matrix_youngs_modulus
ORDER BY
    candidate_score DESC,
    energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    lattice_mismatch_percent ASC,
    shear_modulus DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Al代替またはCo基γ'相候補として有望なL1₂型金属間化合物を、形成エネルギー、格子定数、弾性率の観点から探索して。
sql:
WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.prototype,
        s.lattice_a,
        s.lattice_b,
        s.lattice_c,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.poisson_ratio,
        bool_or(c.element = 'Co') AS contains_co,
        bool_or(c.element = 'Ni') AS contains_ni,
        bool_or(c.element = 'Al') AS contains_al,
        count(DISTINCT c.element) AS n_elements
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.space_group_number = 221
            OR s.space_group IN ('Pm-3m', 'P m -3 m')
        )
    GROUP BY
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        s.space_group,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.prototype,
        s.lattice_a,
        s.lattice_b,
        s.lattice_c,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.poisson_ratio
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    prototype,
    space_group_symbol,
    space_group_number,
    lattice_a AS lattice_constant_a_angstrom,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    energy_above_hull,
    bulk_modulus,
    shear_modulus,
    youngs_modulus,
    poisson_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN contains_co THEN 'Co基γ''候補'
        WHEN contains_ni AND NOT contains_al THEN 'Ni3Al代替候補'
        WHEN NOT contains_ni THEN 'Ni3Al代替候補'
        ELSE 'Ni-Al系L12候補'
    END AS candidate_class,
    (
        COALESCE(formation_energy_per_atom, 0.0) * 10.0
        + COALESCE(energy_above_hull, 0.0) * 20.0
        + ABS(COALESCE(lattice_a, 3.60) - 3.60)
        - COALESCE(youngs_modulus, bulk_modulus, 0.0) / 1000.0
    ) AS screening_score
FROM l12_candidates
WHERE
    formation_energy_per_atom < 0
    AND COALESCE(energy_above_hull, 0) <= 0.05
    AND lattice_a BETWEEN 3.45 AND 3.75
    AND (
        bulk_modulus IS NOT NULL
        OR shear_modulus IS NOT NULL
        OR youngs_modulus IS NOT NULL
    )
    AND formula <> 'Ni3Al'
    AND (
        contains_co
        OR NOT contains_ni
        OR NOT contains_al
    )
ORDER BY
    screening_score ASC,
    energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST,
    youngs_modulus DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

question: γ'相候補のランキングを安定性・格子整合性・バルクモジュラスの重み付きスコアで出して。
sql:
WITH gamma_prime_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.source_material_id AS material_name,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        s.prototype,
        s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
        s.lattice_a,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.52) / 3.52 AS lattice_mismatch,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
        ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            mas.phase ILIKE '%γ′%'
            OR mas.phase ILIKE '%gamma prime%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        )
        AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        1.0 - PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC) AS stability_score,
        1.0 - PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY lattice_mismatch ASC) AS lattice_match_score,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bulk_modulus ASC) AS bulk_modulus_score
    FROM gamma_prime_candidates
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            (
                0.50 * stability_score
              + 0.30 * lattice_match_score
              + 0.20 * bulk_modulus_score
            ) DESC
    ) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    material_name,
    prototype,
    space_group_symbol,
    energy_above_hull,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_mismatch,
    bulk_modulus,
    stability_score,
    lattice_match_score,
    bulk_modulus_score,
    (
        0.50 * stability_score
      + 0.30 * lattice_match_score
      + 0.20 * bulk_modulus_score
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM normalized
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC, energy_above_hull ASC, lattice_mismatch ASC, bulk_modulus DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: NiまたはCo含有で安定かつバルクモジュラスが高いL1₂化合物トップ10を出して。

question: L1₂型化合物の元素組み合わせと安定性の関係をAサイト・Bサイト別に集計して材料設計の指針を得たい。
Ni3Alの格子定数に近く、バルクモジュラスが高く、安定なL1₂候補を総合的にランキングして。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
      ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE regexp_replace(me.formula, '\s+', '', 'g') IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
            s.prototype ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%L1_2%', '%L12%', '%L1₂%', '%Cu3Au%'])
            OR s.space_group_number = 221
          )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
),
l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        AVG(s.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
        MAX(s.prototype) AS prototype,
        MAX(s.space_group_number) AS space_group_number
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
      ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE (
            s.prototype ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%L1_2%', '%L12%', '%L1₂%', '%Cu3Au%'])
            OR s.space_group_number = 221
          )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY me.entry_id, me.formula
),
properties AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
        MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_atom
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
      ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
      ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    GROUP BY me.entry_id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        c.formula,
        c.prototype,
        c.space_group_number,
        c.lattice_a,
        r.ni3al_lattice_a,
        ABS(c.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_delta,
        ABS(c.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a AS relative_lattice_mismatch,
        p.bulk_modulus_gpa,
        p.energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
        EXP(-ABS(c.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / (0.01 * r.ni3al_lattice_a)) AS lattice_match_score,
        p.bulk_modulus_gpa / NULLIF(MAX(p.bulk_modulus_gpa) OVER (), 0) AS bulk_modulus_score,
        EXP(-GREATEST(p.energy_above_hull_ev_atom, 0) / 0.025) AS stability_score
    FROM l12_candidates c
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
    JOIN properties p
      ON p.entry_id = c.entry_id
    WHERE regexp_replace(c.formula, '\s+', '', 'g') NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND p.energy_above_hull_ev_atom <= 0.05
      AND p.bulk_modulus_gpa IS NOT NULL
      AND r.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            0.40 * lattice_match_score
          + 0.35 * bulk_modulus_score
          + 0.25 * stability_score DESC
    ) AS ranking,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    prototype,
    space_group_number,
    lattice_a,
    ni3al_lattice_a,
    lattice_a_delta,
    relative_lattice_mismatch,
    bulk_modulus_gpa,
    energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
    lattice_match_score,
    bulk_modulus_score,
    stability_score,
    0.40 * lattice_match_score
  + 0.35 * bulk_modulus_score
  + 0.25 * stability_score AS comprehensive_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY comprehensive_score DESC, relative_lattice_mismatch ASC, bulk_modulus_gpa DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 析出強化に適したL1₂化合物を格子ミスマッチ、弾性率、安定性の多基準で評価して上位候補を出して。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        s.lattice_a AS precipitate_lattice_a,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
            OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
                AND (
                    s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
                    OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
                    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%3%'
                )
            )
        )
),
l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (le.entry_id)
        le.entry_id,
        le.formula,
        le.precipitate_lattice_a,
        c.element AS matrix_element,
        c.atomic_fraction AS matrix_atomic_fraction,
        le.youngs_modulus,
        le.shear_modulus,
        le.bulk_modulus,
        le.energy_above_hull,
        le.formation_energy
    FROM l12_entries le
    JOIN composition c
        ON c.entry_id = le.entry_id
    WHERE
        c.atomic_fraction >= 0.55
    ORDER BY
        le.entry_id,
        c.atomic_fraction DESC
),
fcc_matrix AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.element)
        c.element,
        me.entry_id AS matrix_entry_id,
        me.formula AS matrix_formula,
        s.lattice_a AS matrix_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN composition c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        c.atomic_fraction >= 0.99
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%fcc%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%A1%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%A1%'
            OR s.space_group_number = 225
        )
    ORDER BY
        c.element,
        CASE
            WHEN s.space_group_number = 225 THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END,
        me.entry_id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        l.entry_id,
        l.formula,
        l.matrix_element,
        fm.matrix_formula,
        l.precipitate_lattice_a,
        fm.matrix_lattice_a,
        CASE
            WHEN fm.matrix_lattice_a IS NOT NULL AND fm.matrix_lattice_a <> 0
            THEN 100.0 * (l.precipitate_lattice_a - fm.matrix_lattice_a) / fm.matrix_lattice_a
        END AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
        l.youngs_modulus,
        l.shear_modulus,
        l.bulk_modulus,
        l.energy_above_hull,
        l.formation_energy,
        (
            0.40 * COALESCE(
                GREATEST(
                    0.0,
                    1.0 - ABS(100.0 * (l.precipitate_lattice_a - fm.matrix_lattice_a) / NULLIF(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 0)) / 5.0
                ),
                0.25
            )
            + 0.30 * COALESCE(
                l.shear_modulus / NULLIF(MAX(l.shear_modulus) OVER (), 0),
                0.0
            )
            + 0.30 * GREATEST(
                0.0,
                1.0 - COALESCE(l.energy_above_hull, 0.20) / 0.20
            )
        ) AS precipitation_strengthening_score
    FROM l12_candidates l
    LEFT JOIN fcc_matrix fm
        ON fm.element = l.matrix_element
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    matrix_element,
    matrix_formula,
    precipitate_lattice_a,
    matrix_lattice_a,
    lattice_mismatch_percent,
    youngs_modulus,
    shear_modulus,
    bulk_modulus,
    energy_above_hull,
    formation_energy,
    precipitation_strengthening_score
FROM scored
WHERE
    COALESCE(ABS(lattice_mismatch_percent), 0.0) <= 5.0
    AND COALESCE(energy_above_hull, 0.0) <= 0.20
ORDER BY
    precipitation_strengthening_score DESC,
    ABS(lattice_mismatch_percent) ASC NULLS LAST,
    energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    shear_modulus DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

question: Co基超合金のγ'相候補として、Co含有で安定なL1₂化合物をNi3Alとの比較で評価して。
sql:
WITH composition_flags AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Co') AS contains_co,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Ni') AS contains_ni,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Al') AS contains_al
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
elastic_moduli AS (
    SELECT
        et.entry_id,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus,
        MAX(et.shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus,
        MAX(et.youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus
    FROM elastic_tensor et
    GROUP BY et.entry_id
),
elastic_constants AS (
    SELECT
        calc.entry_id,
        MAX(cp.value) FILTER (
            WHERE
                LOWER(COALESCE(cp.tensor_component, '')) IN ('c11', '11', '1,1', 'xx,xx')
                OR LOWER(cp.property_name) IN ('c11', 'elastic_c11', 'elastic constant c11', 'elastic tensor c11')
        ) AS c11,
        MAX(cp.value) FILTER (
            WHERE
                LOWER(COALESCE(cp.tensor_component, '')) IN ('c12', '12', '1,2', 'xx,yy')
                OR LOWER(cp.property_name) IN ('c12', 'elastic_c12', 'elastic constant c12', 'elastic tensor c12')
        ) AS c12,
        MAX(cp.value) FILTER (
            WHERE
                LOWER(COALESCE(cp.tensor_component, '')) IN ('c44', '44', '4,4', 'xy,xy')
                OR LOWER(cp.property_name) IN ('c44', 'elastic_c44', 'elastic constant c44', 'elastic tensor c44')
        ) AS c44
    FROM calculation calc
    JOIN calculated_property cp
        ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    GROUP BY calc.entry_id
),
l12_materials AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        s.prototype,
        s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        em.bulk_modulus,
        em.shear_modulus,
        em.youngs_modulus,
        ec.c11,
        ec.c12,
        ec.c44,
        cf.contains_co,
        cf.contains_ni,
        cf.contains_al
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition_flags cf
        ON cf.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_moduli em
        ON em.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_constants ec
        ON ec.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.space_group = 'Pm-3m'
            OR s.space_group_number = 221
        )
        AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.025
),
ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM l12_materials
    WHERE
        contains_ni = TRUE
        AND contains_al = TRUE
        AND formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC, formation_energy_per_atom ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    cand.entry_id,
    cand.formula,
    cand.prototype,
    cand.space_group_symbol,
    cand.energy_above_hull,
    cand.formation_energy_per_atom,
    cand.lattice_a,
    cand.bulk_modulus,
    cand.shear_modulus,
    cand.youngs_modulus,
    cand.c11,
    cand.c12,
    cand.c44,
    ref.formula AS reference_formula,
    ref.energy_above_hull AS ni3al_energy_above_hull,
    ref.formation_energy_per_atom AS ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom,
    ref.lattice_a AS ni3al_lattice_a,
    cand.formation_energy_per_atom - ref.formation_energy_per_atom AS delta_formation_energy_vs_ni3al,
    cand.energy_above_hull - ref.energy_above_hull AS delta_energy_above_hull_vs_ni3al,
    100.0 * (cand.lattice_a - ref.lattice_a) / ref.lattice_a AS lattice_misfit_percent_vs_ni3al,
    cand.bulk_modulus - ref.bulk_modulus AS delta_bulk_modulus_vs_ni3al,
    cand.shear_modulus - ref.shear_modulus AS delta_shear_modulus_vs_ni3al,
    cand.youngs_modulus - ref.youngs_modulus AS delta_youngs_modulus_vs_ni3al,
    CASE
        WHEN cand.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
        WHEN cand.energy_above_hull <= 0.025 THEN 'near-stable'
        ELSE 'metastable'
    END AS stability_label
FROM l12_materials cand
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref ref
WHERE
    cand.contains_co = TRUE
    AND cand.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
ORDER BY
    cand.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ABS(cand.formation_energy_per_atom - ref.formation_energy_per_atom) ASC,
    ABS(100.0 * (cand.lattice_a - ref.lattice_a) / ref.lattice_a) ASC;

question: L1₂型化合物データベースから、バルクモジュラスとせん断弾性率の比(B/G比)を計算して延性候補を抽出して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.prototype,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus,
    ROUND((et.bulk_modulus_vrh / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh, 0))::numeric, 3) AS bg_ratio
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    s.prototype IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND et.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND et.shear_modulus_vrh > 0
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh / et.shear_modulus_vrh >= 1.75
ORDER BY
    bg_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物の安定性マップ（formation energy vs energy above hull）を出力して、候補を4象限に分類して。
sql:
WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        )
        AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
        AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
),
thresholds AS (
    SELECT
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_median,
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_median
    FROM l12_candidates
)
SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.formula,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom,
    c.energy_above_hull,
    CASE
        WHEN c.formation_energy_per_atom <= t.formation_energy_median
         AND c.energy_above_hull <= t.energy_above_hull_median
            THEN 'Q1: low formation energy / low energy above hull - best stability candidates'
        WHEN c.formation_energy_per_atom > t.formation_energy_median
         AND c.energy_above_hull <= t.energy_above_hull_median
            THEN 'Q2: high formation energy / low energy above hull'
        WHEN c.formation_energy_per_atom > t.formation_energy_median
         AND c.energy_above_hull > t.energy_above_hull_median
            THEN 'Q3: high formation energy / high energy above hull - low priority'
        WHEN c.formation_energy_per_atom <= t.formation_energy_median
         AND c.energy_above_hull > t.energy_above_hull_median
            THEN 'Q4: low formation energy / high energy above hull - metastable candidates'
    END AS stability_quadrant
FROM l12_candidates AS c
CROSS JOIN thresholds AS t
ORDER BY
    c.energy_above_hull ASC,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 高温安定性の観点で有望なL1₂型化合物を形成エネルギーの深さで評価して上位を出して。
sql:
WITH tp_max AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        MAX(temperature_k) AS max_stable_temperature_k
    FROM thermal_property
    GROUP BY entry_id
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    tp_max.max_stable_temperature_k
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN tp_max
    ON tp_max.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        ps.is_stable = TRUE
        OR ps.energy_above_hull IS NULL
        OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.10
    )
    AND (
        regexp_replace(replace(lower(coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
        OR regexp_replace(replace(lower(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
        OR regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%cu3au%'
        OR (
            s.space_group_number = 221
            AND upper(coalesce(s.formula_type, '')) IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
        )
    )
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    tp_max.max_stable_temperature_k DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

question: Ni基超合金のγ'相代替候補として、Ni-Al系以外で安定なL1₂化合物を格子整合性で評価して。
sql:
WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
        s.prototype,
        s.lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        string_agg(c.element, '-' ORDER BY c.element) AS alloy_system,
        bool_or(c.element = 'Ni') AS contains_ni,
        bool_or(c.element = 'Al') AS contains_al
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.space_group = 'Pm-3m'
        )
        AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.025
    GROUP BY
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        s.space_group,
        s.prototype,
        s.lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    alloy_system,
    space_group_symbol,
    prototype,
    lattice_a AS l12_lattice_parameter_angstrom,
    3.52 AS ni_gamma_lattice_parameter_angstrom,
    ROUND(((lattice_a - 3.52) / 3.52 * 100.0)::numeric, 3) AS lattice_misfit_percent,
    energy_above_hull,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS((lattice_a - 3.52) / 3.52 * 100.0) <= 0.5
            THEN 'excellent lattice match'
        WHEN ABS((lattice_a - 3.52) / 3.52 * 100.0) <= 1.0
            THEN 'good lattice match'
        WHEN ABS((lattice_a - 3.52) / 3.52 * 100.0) <= 2.0
            THEN 'moderate lattice match'
        ELSE 'poor lattice match'
    END AS lattice_matching_assessment
FROM l12_candidates
WHERE NOT (contains_ni AND contains_al)
ORDER BY
    ABS((lattice_a - 3.52) / 3.52),
    energy_above_hull,
    formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;
